decisions.reason: As a recent extension of the established spraying portfolio, its prospects are still unresolved and the option value of keeping this niche system available likely exceeds the limited incremental cost of continuing it.
This product is close to the firm’s core offer and was given its own page, suggesting a meaningful commitment, so with no clear negative signal yet it is rational to keep the option open.
Because it builds on existing pump and material-handling capabilities, the firm can likely sustain it at low cost while learning about demand, which favors continuation under real options logic.
Fire protection flow monitoring fits the firm’s move toward more future-oriented and interoperable solutions, and after only one year there is too much uncertainty to justify abandonment.
